participant_1.name: Lena
participant_1.personality: Adventurous and curious, Lena enjoys trying new experiences like sky diving and rollercoasters. She's compassionate and values healthy living, which is reflected in her vegan lifestyle.
participant_1.background: I'm not a good swimmer at all. I am a vegan and I love hummus. Hello, I just moved here from Germany. I love rollercoasters and sky diving. I do like watching cooking shows.

participant_2.name: Tony
participant_2.personality: Outgoing and sociable, Tony loves to party and enjoys the fun aspects of life. Despite his fear of heights, he remains very engaged with his surroundings and shows a caring side by volunteering at the food bank.
participant_2.background: My favorite movie is Mean Girls. I'm a party animal. I am deathly afraid of heights. I help out at the food bank occasionally. I own a cat and a dog.
